--------------------S2_a--------------
--------------multi-SPBC UMI groups per chain
-------------------------------------

```{r}
chain_cols <- c("IGH" = "#2f5e8fff", "IGK" = "#1b9e77ff", "IGL" = "#d95f02ff", "TRA" = "#bf8630ff", "TRB" = "#000000ff")
```

```{r}
comcol <- intersect(colnames(nano_17_sd_bcr), colnames(nano_HD_bcr))
```

```{r}
umi_conf_df <- rbind(
    rbind(nano_17_sd_bcr, nano_17_sd_tcr) %>%
      select(comcol) %>%
      mutate(method = "S1_ONT_Q17"),

    rbind(nano_2nd_sd_bcr, nano_2nd_sd_tcr) %>%
      select(comcol) %>%
      mutate(method = "S3_ONT_Q17"),

    rbind(pb_17_sd_bcr, pb_17_sd_tcr) %>%
      select(comcol) %>%
      mutate(method = "S1_PB_Q17"),

    rbind(nano_HD_bcr, nano_HD_tcr) %>%
      select(-any_of(c("spbc"))) %>%
      mutate(spbc=spbcid) %>%
      #mutate(umi = stringr::str_sub(umi, 1, 9)) %>%
      select(comcol) %>%
      mutate(method = "S4_ONT_Q17_HD")) %>%
  filter(!locus %in% c("TRD", "TRG")) %>%
  group_by(locus, method) %>%
  select(locus, umi, spbc, method) %>%
  mutate(total = n()) %>%
  group_by(locus, umi, method, total) %>%
  mutate(count_spbc = n_distinct(spbc)) %>%
  mutate(spbc_confu = count_spbc > 1) %>%
  group_by(locus, method) %>%
  summarise(perc = sum(spbc_confu) / first(total) * 100, .groups = "drop") %>%
  mutate(method = factor(method,levels = c("S1_PB_Q17", "S1_ONT_Q17", "S3_ONT_Q17", "S4_ONT_Q17_HD")))
```


method comparison figure
```{r}
umi_conf_dot <- umi_conf_df %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = method, y = perc, color = locus, group = locus)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 1.6) +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "Cross-SPBC UMI groups (%)", color = NULL) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  scale_color_manual(values = chain_cols) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    legend.box.margin = margin(t = -4),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(0, 0, 0, 0),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.position = "bottom") +
  guides(color=guide_legend(title = ""))
```

```{r, fig.width=3.2, fig.height=3}
s2_a <- umi_conf_dot + plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(l=5, 5, 5, 5)))
s2_a
```

```{r}
save_dir <- file.path("~/mnt_AG_Imkeller/group_members/schuck/manuscripts/longairr/3_revision/3_supplementary/supp2/intermediates/")
#save_plot("figures/corr_igexp_HD.pdf", corr_igexp_plt, base_width = 6.5, base_height = 2.9)
```

--------------------S2_b--------------
--------------SPBCs per UMI across datasets + top10 multi-SPBC UMI groups
-------------------------------------

function set up
```{r}
prep_umi_rank <- function(df, method_label) {
  df %>%
    filter(locus %in% c("IGH", "IGK", "IGL", "TRA", "TRB")) %>%
    group_by(locus, umi) %>%
    summarise(count_spbc = n_distinct(spbc), .groups = "drop") %>%
    group_by(locus) %>%
    arrange(desc(count_spbc), .by_group = TRUE) %>%
    mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
    filter(rank <= 10) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(method = method_label)
}
```

top10 umis with most multi-spbc annotation
```{r}
# top10 umis with most multi-spbc annotation
df_all_umis <- bind_rows(
  prep_umi_rank(rbind(pb_17_sd_bcr, pb_17_sd_tcr), "S1_PB_Q17\n(Visium V1)"),
  prep_umi_rank(rbind(nano_17_sd_bcr, nano_17_sd_tcr),"S1_ONT_Q17\n(Visium V1)"),
  prep_umi_rank(rbind(nano_HD_bcr, nano_HD_tcr), "S4_ONT_Q17_HD\n(Visium HD 3')")) %>%
  mutate(method = factor(method, levels = c("S1_PB_Q17\n(Visium V1)", "S1_ONT_Q17\n(Visium V1)", "S4_ONT_Q17_HD\n(Visium HD 3')")),
    locus = factor(locus, levels = c("IGH", "IGK", "IGL", "TRA", "TRB")))

umis_combined_plot <- df_all_umis %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = factor(rank), y = count_spbc, label = umi)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  geom_text(angle = 90, size = 1.5, hjust = -0.05) +
  facet_grid(method ~ locus, scales = "free", space = "free_x") +
  coord_cartesian(ylim = c(0, 95),clip = "off") +
  labs(x = "UMIs ranked by number of SPBCs", y = "Number of SPBCs\nper UMI") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 7) +
  theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major = element_line(linewidth = 0.25, color = "grey88"),
    panel.border = element_rect(linewidth = 0.2),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(t = 2)),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 7, color = "black", margin = margin(r = 2)),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 6, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text.x = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(size = 6.5, color = "black"),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "gray92", color = "grey50", linewidth = 0.2),
    plot.margin = margin(2, 2, 2, 2),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    plot.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA))
```

```{r, fig.width=4, fig.height=4.5}
s2_b <- umis_combined_plot + plot_annotation(theme = theme(plot.margin = margin(l=5, 5, 5, 5)))
s2_b
```

```{r}

#save_plot("figures/corr_igexp_HD.pdf", corr_igexp_plt, base_width = 6.5, base_height = 2.9)
saveRDS(s2_b, file=file.path(save_dir, "s2_b.rds"))
```
